products.product_description: Fresh Atlantic Salmon. No finished packaging. Fresh Salmon is placed in white styrofoam box and delivered to area restaurants.
products.code_info: No codes. Production date from 05/27/14 to 05/28/2014.
products.reason_for_recall: Firm is initiating a voluntary recall of Fresh Farmed Atlantic Salmon and Fresh Wild Tuna because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. Firm was notified that FDA environmental swab samples had a positive result for Listeria monocytogenes.
